verdicts.label: NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: Crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru on multiple occasions over the years, and warning signs are in place. However, there are no credible reports confirming a sighting of two crocodiles on October 7, 2026.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple news reports from different years (2010, 2023, 2024, 2026) confirm that crocodiles have been spotted in Kukkarahalli Lake. However, none of the provided evidence corroborates the specific claim that two crocodiles were seen on October 7, 2026. All cited reports mention single crocodiles on different dates. Without a specific report for the claimed date and number of animals, the claim remains unproven.
